info.name: Weld REST Connection Bridge Reverse ETL Failed Records API
List Reverse ETL Sync Failed Record Errors

params.name: reverse_etl_sync_id
params.description: The ID of the Reverse ETL Sync to fetch record errors for.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of record errors to return.

items.docs: List the unresolved record errors captured for the specified Reverse ETL Sync.

info.name: Get Reverse ETL Sync Failed Record count

params.name: reverse_etl_sync_id
params.description: The ID of the Reverse ETL Sync to fetch record errors for.

items.docs: Get the number of unresolved failed records captured for the specified Reverse ETL Sync.

info.name: Retry Reverse ETL Sync Failed Records

params.name: reverse_etl_sync_id
params.description: The ID of the Reverse ETL Sync to fetch record errors for.

items.docs: Retries the given record IDs on the specified Reverse ETL Sync at the next run by resetting their errors.

info.name: Retry all Reverse ETL Sync Failed Records

params.name: reverse_etl_sync_id
params.description: The ID of the Reverse ETL Sync to fetch record errors for.

items.docs: Retries all failed records captured for the specified Reverse ETL Sync at the next run by resetting their errors.
